content: Pol yisola la nɨmba kat vɨlaa wandɨ. Wuna yakwa nɨmba, wun kavle vat ana yiwun vlɨlgowun. Woseka ana wowun God vɨlɨgandɨ. Tat kavle vat ana yiwun. Mbambala kavle vat ana yigiyowun.
Pol wan nyaangɨt mbutɨndɨ maa God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nyan Ananaias Polna ngwaymba la nyan kat wandɨ. Tɨpwimba aviya waa wandɨ.

Pol Ananaias kat wandɨ. Wun kat viyanda vla mɨn kat God viyaigandɨ. Nat nɨmba mɨn kat vɨga yelavɨtɨgandi. Ndɨ apma nyana waa yelavɨtɨgandi. Mɨn apma nyan ana mɨn. Mɨn kavle maawut yelavɨka lɨga nyan mɨn. Wun kat vɨga yelavɨtɨgamɨn. An nyan Moses kwiya lomba ana yetɨlɨgandɨ waa yelavɨtɨgamɨn. Mɨnogwi wungivat sɨgat. Mɨno Moses kwiya lomba ana yetɨlɨgamɨn. Tɨpwimba aviya waa Moses kwiya lo kat kai waa kalɨpmɨn.
Polna ngwaymba lɨga nɨmba ndɨ kat wandi. Kavle nyaangɨt wama nyan God kat kwunatɨga nɨmbana njambwi nyana waa wandi.
Pol wandɨ. Yakwa nɨmba, njambwi nyanat tɨnda vat ana vɨwun. Vɨga yiwan kavle nyaangɨt ana ngambugewun. Njambwi nyan kat kavle nyaangɨt ke waga waa pɨlɨwutndi.

Yisola la njambwi nɨmba kat Pol vɨlaa yelavɨtndi. Ndina nat nɨmba Ferisis walɨnja nɨmba yetɨlɨga vapmba yetɨlɨgandi. Wan mbaapma vlɨlɨlɨk tɨnja vak kat yelavɨtaa wandɨ. Yakwa nɨmba wun Ferisi wun. Wuna nyaek Ferisia. Kiya nɨmba laakiyandi waa wawa vak kat wutaa wun kat kwutaa kalindi waa wandɨ Pol.
Pol wandɨ maa Ferisio Satusio nɨma vat ngambuga waleandi.

Satusina vak kɨngiyan. Kupma yelavɨtɨgandi. Kiyaa nɨmba ana laakiyandi. Ensel kai ana lɨgandi. Waagan kai ana lɨgandi waa yelavɨtɨgandi. Ferisina vat kɨngiyan. Wupma yelavɨtɨgandi. Kiyaa nɨmba ngɨni laakiyandi. Ensel waagan tɨgandi waa yelavɨtɨgandi.

Wungi kat tɨga nɨma kwundimba ngambuga waleandi. Moses kwiya nyaangɨt sɨmagwilɨga nɨmba Ferisina nɨmba laataa nɨma kwundimba wandi. Yilɨngwa vat ana nglaatndɨ. Wan nyan kavle vat yilɨnda vat ana vɨnɨn. Ensel ndɨ kat anagandɨ mbukna. Waaga ndɨ kat anagandɨ mbukna waa wandi.
Nɨma vat ngumbuga waleandi. Romba lɨga yaa njambwi nyan Pol kat kavle vat yigiyandi waa vaatɨndɨ. ndɨna soldia kat wandɨ. Ngwuk ndina nɨndɨmba ndailaa Pol kat kwutaa ngwula ngayat kali waa wandɨ.
Ngan njambwi nyan Jisas Polna ngaymba laataa lɨga ndɨ kat wandɨ. Ke vapma. Wun kat Jerusalemba lɨga nɨmba kat mbupmɨn. Wun kat Romba lɨga nɨmba kat mbukiyamɨn waa wandɨ.
POL KAT VATNYAVAT YELAVƗTNDI
Ngambi Juda nɨma sakwat yisolaa lɨga wandi. Nɨn nao ana kɨgiyanɨn. Nɨn ngu ana kɨgiyanɨn. Pol kat vatnyala lɨga nao kɨga ngu kɨgiyanɨn. Pol kat vatnyala lɨga nao kɨga ngu kɨgiyanɨn waa wandi.
Yisola lɨga wan nyaangɨt wala nɨmbana sakwat ndumi vɨli nɨmba kat kwutlatɨndɨ.
Wan nɨmba God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmbagwi kan ngepmana njambwi nɨmba kat yiga wandi. Nɨn vanɨn. Nao ana kɨgiyanɨn. Ngu ana kɨgiyan. Pol kat vatnyalaa lɨga ngɨni nao kɨga ngu kɨgiyanɨn wanɨn.

Wungi kat tɨga Romba lɨga yaa njambwi nyan kat nyaangɨt awa ngwula. Pol kat kwutaa agiya awa. Angwa nyaangɨt wupmat wanɨn waa awa. Ngwuk kat vɨvat yalɨndɨ mala ndɨ kat nɨndɨ ava yambɨnba vatnyagiyanɨn waa wandi.
Polna laawa ndina nyaangɨt wutaa soldiana ngay wuleilaa Pol kat mbutndɨ.
Pol kat mbutndɨ maa Pol njambwi soldia kat wandɨ. Yagwa. Mɨn kat nyaangɨt mbupmak wowun. Wan kwandɨ nyan kat kwutaa mɨna njambwi nyan kat kali. Nyaangɨt ngilɨga waa wandɨ Pol.

Njambwi soldia ndɨ kat kwutaa ndɨna njambwi nyan kat kalilaa ndɨ kat wandɨ. kalabusmba lɨga nyan Pol wun kat wandɨ. Wan nyan kat kwutaa mɨna njambwi nyan kat kali. Nyaangɨt ngilɨga waa wandɨ Pol waa wandɨ njambwi soldia.
Njambwi nyan kwandɨ nyan kat taambamba kwutaa samat kalindɨ. Nat nɨmbamba wutandi walaa kalindɨ. Kalilaa wagalandɨ. Anda nyaangɨtna. Wun kat ambuk waa wagalandɨ.
Kwandɨ nyan wandɨ. Kinya Juda mɨn kat waigandi. Pol kat agiya waa waigandi. Angwa kwundi wupmat wanɨn waa waigandi.

Ndina nyaangɨt ke wupma. Ndumi vɨli la nɨmba kwulata nɨmba pagwuga ndɨ kat vatnyavat kwiga lɨgandi. Wundi nɨmba wandi. Nao ana kɨgiyanɨn. Ngu ana kɨgiyanɨn. Pol kat vatnyalaa lɨga ngɨni nao kɨga ngu kɨgiyanɨn waa wandi. mbambala ndɨ kat vatnyavat kawiga lɨgandi. Ndɨ kat kalimerya njɨmbla kat kawiga lɨgandi waa wandɨ kwandɨ nyan.
Njambwi nyan ndɨ kat wandɨ. Wun kat mbupma nyaangɨt nat nɨmba kat ke yiga mbuka. Ay mɨla waa wandɨ.
VƗGA LA NYAN FILIKS KAT POL KAT KWUTAA KALINDI

Walaa njambwi nyan ndɨna kwupmba la mbɨt vlɨlɨlɨk soldia kat wandɨ. mamba veilɨga soldia 200, hosna mbunimba wataa yalɨga soldia 70, nɨmbi nda kwutaa lɨga soldia 200 kwutaa Sisariat ay, Pol kat kwutaa kaligiyangwuk. Mbambala ngan 9 klok wan ngepma kwagalalaa yigiyangwuk.
Hos kuvuk yiga kwutaa kiyaa Pol wungi hosna mbunimba ndaalɨga yigiyandɨ. Sisariamba lɨga vɨga lɨga nyan kat Pol kat kaligiyamɨn. Vɨga lɨga nyana sɨ Filiks waa wandɨ.
Njambwi nyan Filiks kat pas pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Wun Klodias waa Lisias walɨnja nyan wun. Wan pas wun pɨlɨwutɨgowun. Mɨn vɨga lɨga nyan mɨn Filiks kat wan pas pɨlɨwutɨgowun. mɨn njambwi nyan mɨn.
Wan nyan Polndɨ kat Juda kwutaa vatnyavat wandi. Pol Romba la nyanat tɨnda kat wutaa ndɨnai lɨga vat tɨvat yiwun.
Ndina nyaangɨtna angwa kwundi wupma Pol kat kwutaa ndina njambwi nɨmba la kavat kaliwun.
Wan nyaangɨt wutaa yelavɨkwun. Nɨna lo ana kalɨtndɨ waa yelavɨkwun. yelavɨtaa wowun. Ndɨ kat ke vatnyaga. Ndɨ kat kalabusmba ke taagaga waa wowun. Ndina lo Judana yetɨla lo mɨna kalɨtndɨ.

Nat Juda ndɨ kat vatnyavat tɨnja vat wutwun. Wungi kat tɨga mɨn kat yindɨ. Ndɨ kat kavle nyaangɨt ngambulɨga nɨmba kat wowun. Wan nyaangɨt Filiks kat yiga ambuk waa wowun waa nyaangɨtmba yindi. Pol kat kwutaa Antipatris walɨnja ngepmat kalindi. Wan ngepma ngan yiga wuleindi.

Nat nandinya mamba veilɨga soldia ndi kat kwagalalaa lungwamataa soldiana ngayat yindi. Hosna mbunimba wataa yalɨga soldia Pol kat kwutaa Sisariat kalindi. Vɨga la nyan wan pas vɨlaa Pol kat wagalandɨ. Mɨna angwa ngepma anda nɨma kɨpmamba lɨgandɨ waa wagalandɨ. Pol wandɨ silisia walɨnja nɨma kɨpmamba lɨgandɨ.

Wungi kat tɨga vɨga la nyan wandɨ. Wovuna. Mɨn kat kavle nyaangɨt ngambula nɨmba yandi mala mɨna nyaangɨt wukiyowun waa wandɨ. Tat Herot kwutnda nɨma ngaymba Pol kat yiga taagandɨ. Pol wan ngaymba yetɨndɨ. Nat nɨmba ndɨ kat vɨga lɨndi.
